2a2(mdo): bdag po dang /de ma yin ba gzhan lha dang /klu dang /gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang /lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang /myi 'am ci dang /lto 'phe chen po brgya stong mang po dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs so //yang de'i
2a3(mdo): tshe de'i dus na 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyurd pa ri zhig gi bang rim gyi ngos la /skyes bu dam pa nyi shu rtsa lnga dang lhan gcig du gnas pa 'd-i lta ste /byang chub sems dpa' klu dpal dang /klus byin dang /dpal 'byung dang
2a4(mdo): dpal gyi snying bo dang /pad ma bl-i'i dpal dang /pad ma dpal 'byung dang /skye bo 'dzind pa dang /sa 'dzind dang /lag na rin cen phyag rgya dang /seng ge blo gros dang /seng ge'i 'gros bsgrags dbyangs
2a5(mdo): dang /nam mkha' mdzod dang /sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo sgyur ba dang /ch-ig gi dbang rab tu tha dad pa thams cad la spobs pa dang /spobs pa'i phung po dang /blo gros rgya mtsho dang /lhun po chen
2a6(mdo): po dang /mthong na dga' ba dang /rab tu dga' ba'i rgyal po dang /mtha' yas mthong ba dang /mtha' yas dmy-igs par gnas pa dang /bdud kyi lta ba yang dag par 'jom pa dang /mya ngan myed sbyin dang /don thams cad grub
2a7(mdo): pa'-i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang /skyes bu dam pa nyi shu rtsa lnga po de dag dang lhan gcig tu gnas so //dga' ldan ris kyi lha'i bu bzhi yang chos nyand pa'i phyir /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyurd pa'i phyi bzh-in
2a8(mdo): 'brang bar gyurd te /lha'i bu kun nas me tog ces bya ba dang /lha'i bu me tog 'od zer can zhes bya ba dang /lha'i bu mo tog man da ra'-i dri zhes bya ba dang /lha'i bur chos la gnas pa rtag tu brtson pa zhes bya ba de dag dang /lha'i bu mang
2a9(mdo): po gzhan dag kyang 'di lta ste /chos nyand pa'i phyir 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyu rad pa'i phyi bzhin du 'brang bar gyurd to //de lta ste skyes bu dam pa de dang /lha'i bu de dag tshogs sh-ing 'khod pa las /bar skabs su kye grogs po
2b1(mdo): dag sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni ni rgya che ba dpag tu myed pa /tshad myed pa bsam gy-is myi khyab pa /mnyam pa myed pa /gzhal du myed pa /myi rtogs pa /myi mnyam ba dang mnyam ba /bla na myed pa yin te /de ni go cha dam pa ma yin bas
2b2(mdo): rtogs par myi nus na /go cha ji tsam zhig bgos na thams cad mkhyend pa'-i ye shes /ye shes chen po de rtogs par nus shes /de lta bu'-i gtam brjod par gyurd pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' klu dpal gy-is smras pa /dge ba'-i rtsa 
2b3(mdo): ba'i tshogs bsags pa /bsngo bas chog my-i shes pa'i dge ba'-i rtsa ba la gzhol bar gnas sh-ing my-i brjed pa'i cho ga bgos pas /ye shes chen po de rtos par nus so //byang chub sems dpa' klul sbyin kyis smras pa /sems
2b4(mdo): snyoms pa dang /sems dul ba dang /sems 'jaM pa dang seMs la dang /sems mnyen ba dang /sems cang shes pa'-i phyir thams cad mkhyend pa'i ye shes kyi yi dam brtan po snying po la gnas pa'i go cha bgos pas /thams cad mkhyend pa'i
2b5(mdo): ye shes /ye shes chen por rtogs par nus so //byang cub sems dpa' dpal 'byung gyis smras pa /kye grogs po dag bskald pa'i grangs kyis ye shes chen po de rtogs par myi nus kyi /bskald pa dpag
2b6(mdo): tu myed par go cha bgos pas thams cad mkhyend pa'i ye shes rtogs par nus so /byang chub sems dpal gyi snying pos smras pa /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' bdag gi bde ba la ni chags shing /

2b8(mdo): cad la stobs so zhes sems can thams cad bde zhing /bde ba dang ldan pa la gzhog par byed pa des /thams cad mkhyend pa'i ye shes de rtogs par nus so //byang chub sems dpa' pad ma bla'-i dpal gyis smras pa
2b9(mdo): bdag nyid ma dul ma bsrungs ma byang ba des /pha rol ma dul ma bsrungs ma byang ba /dul bar bya ba dang /zh-i bar bya ba'i gnas de ni myed kyi /bdag nyid shind tu dul la /shind tu bsrungs /shind tu byang ba des /
3a1(mdo): //pha rold ma dul ma bsrungs ma byang ba /dul bar bya ba dang /zhi bar bya ba'-i gnas de ni yod do /zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang de skad gsungs te /de bas na dul ba dang zhi gnas kyi rnal 'byord la zhugs
3a2(mdo): shing /pha rold dul ba dang /zhi gnas dang 'thun bar bya ba la mkhas pas /ye shes chen po de rtogs par nus so //byang chub sems dpa' pad ma dpal byung gyis smras pa /kye grogs po dag 'j-ig rten kyi chos
3a3(mdo): dang 'brel bas /'jig rten las 'das par myi nus kyi /gang 'jig rten kyi chos dang ma 'brel ba de n-i 'jig rten las 'da' bar 'gyur ro //de bas na byang chub sems dpa' gang rnyed pa dang /myi rnyed pa dang /
3a4(mdo): grags pa dang /ma grags pa dang /bstod pa dang /smad pa dang /bde ba dang /sdug bsngal bas myi 'phrogs shing /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ma khengs pa ma smad pa des ni /ye shes

3a6(mdo): par myi nus kyi /gc-ig pu gnyis su myed la /bdag g-is sems can thams cad kyi phyir /go cha chen po bgos pas /sems can thams cad kyi gang ci yang rung yongs su thob par
3a7(mdo): bya ba de thams cad /bdag g-is yongs su thob par bya'o zhes dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dang /sems can thams cad yongs su smyind par bya ba'i phyir //de sems can thams cad dang thun mong du sems bskyed de
3a8(mdo): yud tsam du 'ang brtson 'grus myi gtong zhing /de ltar brtson 'grus la gnas pa'-i byang chub sems dpa' ye shes chen po de rtogs par nus so //byang chub sems dpa' sa 'dzind kyis smras pa /kye grogs po
3a9(mdo): dag 'di lta ste dper na /sa ni ph+wa dang /shing gel ba dang /sman dang /nags tshal thams cad kyi gnas yin te /de la gnas shing ph+wa dang /shing gel ba dang /sman dang /nags chal gyi sa bon thams cad skye bar
3b1(mdo): bar 'gyur mod kyi /sa chen po de ni lan la re ba yang myed do //sems can thams cad kyang sa chen po las 'tsho mod kyi /sa chen po ni skyo bar yang myi byed do //r-igs kyi bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' chags pa dang /zhe 
3b2(mdo): sdang ba'i sems dang bral ba dang /sems can thams cad kyi nye bar 'tsho ba dang /lan re ba myed pa'i phyir /sa dang 'dra bar sems bskyed na /ye shes chen po de rtogs par nus so //byang chub sems dpa' lag na rin cen
3b3(mdo): gyis smras pa /kye grogs po dag 'di ni go cha chen po yin te /dman ba la mos pas ni ye shes chen po de rtogs par myi nus kyi //gang gnyid log pa'i rmi lam na yang theg pa gny-is la sems myi 'jug c-ing /rin po che
3b4(mdo): 'i sems thams cad mkhyend pa'-i sems de pha rold dag kyang 'dod par byed du 'jug la /r-in po che'i sems de la ser sna myi byed da kyi /sems can thams cad kyang theg pa chen po'i go cha de bskond 
3b5(mdo): par byed cing /sems mnyam ba myed pa de 'ang /gang ba'am bri ba ra myi mthong zhing /de ltar ser sna myed pa'i sems kyis /ye shes chen po de rtog par nus so //byang chu ba sems dpa' lag na
3b6(mdo): rin cen phyag rgyas smras pa //kye ma'o sems can 'di dag ni 'gro ba drug du ltung gyis /de dag de dag tu snying rje chen po bskyed de /sems can thams cad la chos kyi phyag rgya /rin po che'i phyag rgya gsum gyis

8a4(mdo): zag tshul khrims dang ldan ba'i sems kyi smond pa 'grub /smon la ma 'grub par 'gyur la /tshul khrims kyi rtsa ba la yang bag byed pa rtend /bag byed pa'i rtsa ba la yang /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos

8b1(mdo): tan thams cad dang ldan bas /thams cad mkhyend pa rtogs so //lha'i bu me tog 'od zer dang ldan ba yang /gang gi tshe na chos kyi snang ba gtong ba de'i tshe /ma rig pa dang glen pa'i mun pas bsgr-ibs pa'i sems can rnams la /
